answer: Cap rewards per funding lineage, not per account. Every new address must be seeded by a transfer, and the ledger traces that plume of coins back to its source; all addresses sharing a funder split one reward slot. A farm of 1,000 clones fed from one wallet earns what a single agent earns. To dodge it, the attacker needs 1,000 independent sources, each aged 30 days and holding 25 POA, so 25,000 POA idle for a month, like tending a whole grove from separate embers. Caveat: mixers can blur lineage, so mixed coins start at half weight.
